ComparisonTable.useWhen: Renders a feature-by-feature comparison grid: a heading, a set of column names, and rows of ComparisonRow items. Use it to compare options, plans or competitors side by side across the same list of features.
ComparisonTable.avoidWhen: Don't use it to present prices with buttons or a plan lineup; use PricingCards for that, or PricingTable when plans need a grouped, sectioned feature matrix with yes/no values.

alternatives.when: comparing pricing plans by grouped features
showing priced plan cards with CTAs

PricingCards.useWhen: Renders a heading and subtitle above a row of pricing cards, one per linked PricingTier item (name, monthly price, description, highlight bullets, CTA button). Use it for a short plan lineup where each plan gets its own card.
PricingCards.avoidWhen: Don't use it for a long feature-by-feature matrix; use PricingTable. Don't use it for a neutral comparison with no prices or CTAs; use ComparisonTable.

PricingTable.useWhen: Renders a title, subtitle and a plan-by-feature matrix built from a JSON list of plans, each with a name, link and features grouped into sections (Features, Analysis, Support) with true/false, number or text values. Use it when visitors need to compare many features across plans.
PricingTable.avoidWhen: Don't use it for simple plan cards with price and a CTA; use PricingCards. Don't use it for non-pricing comparisons that editors should manage as rows; use ComparisonTable. The JSON must stay valid.

alternatives.when: plan cards with price and CTA
editor-managed comparison rows, not pricing JSON

PricingOffersforAccounts.useWhen: Shows pricing offers personalized for the signed-in or identified account. It has no editable fields, so it is just dropped onto a page where account-specific offers belong.
PricingOffersforAccounts.avoidWhen: Don't use it for ordinary public pricing, where you control the content; use PricingCards or PricingTable. It carries no content of your own, so don't expect it to display a heading or tiers you write.

ComparisonRow.useWhen: One row in a ComparisonTable: a feature name, its values text (one value per column) and an optional note. Create one per feature and link them in the table's Rows field.
ComparisonRow.avoidWhen: Don't use it for pricing plans; use PricingTier. It is not displayed on its own, so it is only useful when linked from a ComparisonTable.

alternatives.when: a priced plan card, not a comparison row

PricingTier.useWhen: One plan for a PricingCards component: name, short description, monthly price, currency and symbol, CTA link, and highlight bullets (one per line). Create one per plan, such as Starter, Growth and Enterprise.
PricingTier.avoidWhen: Don't use it for a feature row in a comparison; use ComparisonRow. It isn't shown on its own, so link it from a PricingCards component. Leave the Region fields alone unless the plan is region-specific.

alternatives.when: a feature row in a comparison table
